answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy stakes validator identities: each raven validator posts a bond, and every identity an operator controls costs quadratically more, so a violet swarm of fifty clones burns far more capital than one honest node. Honest grading returns the bond; cloned grading slashes it forever. This stake-weighted attestation makes jade-grade trust expensive to fake, even as a comet sweeps the tundra of cheap clones.
